FractionHP.name: Hit Points Attribute Data Path
FractionHP.hint: Your system might be using another data path. If the estimate isn't showing correctly, input the data path to the correct attribute.

FractionMath.name: Fraction Equation
FractionMath.hint: Your system's HP equation might be different than the default, choose the equation used to estimate the health fraction.

ignoreColor.name: Ignore Color
ignoreColor.hint: Ignores the colors from this table and uses the colors from the next valid table for the token. This is intended for conditions that should take priority over an estimate, but still reflect the estimate's color scheme.

markDead.name: Mark as Dead
markDead.hint: Marks all the selected tokens as Dead. If all the selected tokens are already Dead, they'll be reset to alive.

dontMarkDead.name: Don't Mark as Dead
dontMarkDead.hint: Makes NPCs to not be shown as Dead when its estimate reaches 0. This is only useful if you're using the {setting} setting.

hideEstimates.name: Hide Estimates from Players
hideEstimates.hint: Hidden estimates will be shown with an asterisk (*) for the GM.

combatOnly.name: Show Only on Combat
combatOnly.hint: Shows the estimates only when a combat is active.

showDescription.name: Show Estimates: Users
showDescription.hint: Show estimates to the following users.

showDescriptionTokenType.name: Show Estimates: Tokens
showDescriptionTokenType.hint: Show estimates of the following tokens.

deathState.name: Death State on Condition
deathState.hint1: Show token as defined on the {setting} setting when it has been affected by any condition that uses the icon set on the {setting2} setting.
deathState.hint2: Show token as defined on the {setting} setting when it has been marked as defeated on combat.

deathStateName.name: Dead State Name
deathStateName.hint: The description shown when a token is dead.

deathMarker.name: Death Marker
deathMarker.hint: Path to the condition icon that marks the dead tokens.

tooltipPosition.name: Elevation Tooltip Position
tooltipPosition.hint: Moves the Elevation Tooltip to avoid conflicts with the Estimate when rendered at the top of the token.

NPCsJustDie.name: NPCs Just Die
NPCsJustDie.hint: NPCs are shown as Dead when they reach the last health stage.

addTemp.name: Add Temporary Health
addTemp.hint: Include temporary health points in calculating what description to show.

fontSize.name: Font Size
fontSize.hint: Accepts any valid property for CSS font-size

useColor.name: Use Color
useColor.hint: The estimates will be shown in black and white.

smoothGradient.name: Smooth Gradient
smoothGradient.hint: With this setting off the color will only change when the next description is reached, with it on it will reflect the health percentage.

position.name: Height
position.hint: The height is set relative to the token's frame. Negative values push it higher; positive, lower.

position2.name: Position
position2.hint: The position relative to the token's frame.

positionAdjustment.name: Margin Adjustment
positionAdjustment.hint: Adjust the text's margin. Positive values push it higher; negative, lower.

scaleToGridSize.name: Scale Estimates to Grid Size
scaleToGridSize.hint: Scales the estimate based on the grid size.

gridSize.name: Base Grid Size
gridSize.hint: The baseline grid size for the scaling. Useful for map packs that use different grid sizes.

scaleToTokenSize.name: Scale to Token Size
scaleToTokenSize.hint: Scales the estimates based on the token's width.

scaleToZoom.name: Scale Estimates to Zoom
scaleToZoom.hint: Scales the estimate based on the zoom distance.

notifications.toggleEstimate: {tokenName}'s health estimate is being {term} from players.

tempHP.name: Temporary Hit Points Attribute Data Path
tempHP.hint: Leave it blank if the system doesn't have one or if you don't want it to be added to the estimation.

impaired.name: Health level for Impaired PCs
impaired.hint: Sets the maximum health level (current / maximum, fraction 0.0 - 1.0) that can be reported for a PC that is Impaired on the Death Track

debilitated.name: Health level for Debilitated PCs
debilitated.hint: Sets the maximum health level (current / maximum, fraction 0.0 - 1.0) that can be reported for a PC that is Debilitated on the Death Track

addNonlethal.name: Use Nonlethal Damage
addNonlethal.hint: If enabled nonlethal damage will be substracted from current health for estimation.

showExtra.name: Show {condition1} & {condition2}
showExtra.hint: Shows the {condition1} and {condition2} descriptions when their prerequisites are fulfilled.

staminaToHp.name: Stamina to Estimate
staminaToHp.hint: Add Stamina Points to the estimate.

workbenchMystifier.name: (EXPERIMENTAL) PF2e Workbench's Mystifier Support
workbenchMystifier.hint: If the NPC Mystification settings are enabled, Chat Outputs will ignore the {setting} setting's name and use the token's name if it is different from its actor's Prototype Token's name.

countPools.name: Count Empty Pools
countPools.hint: Count empty pools instead of sum of their values, with the estimation only changing when a pool is depleted or replenished.

useThreshold.name: Use Vehicle Threshold
useThreshold.hint: Defines which estimation table will be used when calculating a Vehicle's estimatives.

addStamina.name: Account for Stamina
addStamina.hint: With this setting on, Stamina will be added to HP for calculations.

simpleRule.name: Estimation Rule
simpleRule.hint: The JS formula for calculating the fraction of health token has. Alter with caution. Default assumes simple descending health, e.g. you start with 10/10 in your health field and go down to 0/10 when taking damage.

defaultWildCardMaxWounds.name: Default Wild Card's Max Wounds
defaultWildCardMaxWounds.hint: This is used to calculate the max wounds a Wild Card NPC should have by default for estimations.

showIncap.name: {incap} Status Effect
showIncap.hint: Tokens with the {incap} Status Effect will be shown as {incap} instead of their current estimates. Doesn't work for tokens that are vehicles or dead.
